book.name: 1 TESALONICENSES
book.title: U BꞌAXA Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLO XEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU TESALOONICA U bꞌaxa uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Tesalónica uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: Niyolon u Pablo tiꞌ unqꞌa txumbꞌal uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn vatz u Tiixh

As cheel, qitzꞌin qatzik, la kujaj bꞌaꞌnil sete. As la kubꞌeya sete tukꞌ vibꞌii u Kubꞌaal Jesús tiꞌ uvaꞌ kam kat kuchus sete tiꞌ ebꞌanat u bꞌaꞌneꞌ vatz Aak, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la chiibꞌ veꞌt Aak setiꞌ as yeꞌ la yaꞌ ex tiꞌ ebꞌanat u bꞌaꞌneꞌ. Pet aal la chꞌii u bꞌaꞌneꞌ tu vetaanxelaleꞌ,
tan ootzimal veꞌteꞌ setaꞌn kam unqꞌa chusbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ kat qal sete taꞌn u Kubꞌaal Jesús.
As aꞌ nisaꞌ u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ la eteesa veꞌt el etibꞌ vatz u paaveꞌ. As yeꞌ la paavin ex tiꞌ eyansat etibꞌ tukꞌ umaꞌtoj uxhchil.
As junun chit ex la etootzi etixqel tijikil. As txaich aama etatin savatzaj.
As yeꞌ la etaqꞌ tachaꞌv vechiꞌoleꞌ, echeꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌan unqꞌa tenameꞌ uveꞌ yeꞌ ootzin tetz u Tiixheꞌ.

As yeꞌxhebꞌil la bꞌanon umaj vaꞌlexh te u titzꞌin etatzikeꞌ. As mitaꞌn la imaxtibꞌe u titzꞌin etatzikeꞌ tiꞌ teesat vimooleꞌ tu bꞌey, tan aꞌ u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ la bꞌanon ichꞌexel ste tiꞌ unqꞌa vaꞌlexheꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat qal sete.
As jit tiꞌ kubꞌanat u vaꞌlexheꞌ kat imolokat oꞌ u Tiixheꞌ. Pet tiꞌ uvaꞌ oꞌ veꞌt tetz Aak la ibꞌaneꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la kubꞌaneꞌ kam uvaꞌ nisaꞌ Aak sqiꞌ.
As abꞌil la ixvan unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni qal sete, as jit oꞌeꞌ ni qixvaleꞌ. Pet aꞌ u Tiixheꞌ ni tixvaleꞌ uveꞌ ni aqꞌon u Tiixhla Espíritu sqe.
As jit tzꞌajinal la kutzꞌibꞌa bꞌen umaꞌl u yoleꞌ sete tiꞌ u xoꞌniibꞌeꞌ, tan chusel veꞌt ex taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ nexoꞌnikat etibꞌ sevatzaj.

As nexoꞌni veꞌt unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ skajayil uveꞌ at tu u Macedonia. Pet la unjaj bꞌaꞌnil sete, qitzꞌin qatzik, uvaꞌ yeꞌ la yaꞌ ex tiꞌ exoꞌnit etibꞌ sevatzaj. Pet aal la yakꞌin ex tiꞌ exoꞌnit etibꞌ.
As la eyaꞌlu etibꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ la ok u yaaibꞌeꞌ sexoꞌl. As etoksataj etaama tiꞌ ebꞌanat vetaqꞌoneꞌ as tiꞌ etaqꞌonveꞌ tukꞌ veqꞌabꞌeꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat qal kan sete,
aqꞌal uvaꞌ jik chit etxumbꞌal vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ ootzin tetz u Tiixheꞌ. As yeꞌxhkam kuxh la saꞌvit veꞌt setiꞌ.
Niyolon u Pablo tiꞌ u tulebꞌal u Jesús unpajte

As nu kusaꞌ, qitzꞌin qatzik, uvaꞌ la etootzi isuuchil tiꞌ uvaꞌ kam la ibꞌan unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uvaꞌ kamnajle, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌ la txumun ex echeꞌ nibꞌan unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl kꞌujlebꞌal ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ul taama unqꞌa kamnajeꞌ unpajte.
Tan nu kunima uvaꞌ kat kam u Jesús, as kat ul taama Aak unpajte. As echat kuxh la ibꞌan u Tiixheꞌ te unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús uvaꞌ kamnajle, tan la ul taama unpajte tul la ul u Jesús.

Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ ni qal isuuchil u yoleꞌ sete uvaꞌ kat tal u Kubꞌaal Jesúseꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ jankꞌal oꞌ uvaꞌ isleꞌltel oꞌ tul uvaꞌ la ul Aak unpajte, as yeꞌl oꞌ la bꞌax oꞌ vatz unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uvaꞌ kamnajle,

tan tul la ul u Kubꞌaaleꞌ tu almikaꞌ, as la tal Aak tul taama unqꞌa niman tetzeꞌ uvaꞌ kamnajle. As la taqꞌ jeꞌ vibꞌooqꞌol unqꞌa ángel tuul iviꞌ tiꞌ isikꞌineꞌ. As la oqꞌsal umaꞌl u trompeta tetz u Tiixheꞌ. As la ul veꞌt taama unqꞌa kamnajeꞌ bꞌaxa uveꞌ niman tetz Aak.
As aꞌn la eqꞌol veꞌt jeꞌ oꞌ tu u suutzꞌeꞌ, jankꞌal oꞌ uvaꞌ isleꞌltel oꞌ tul la ul Aak. As la kukꞌul veꞌt qibꞌ tukꞌ Aak tu kajiqꞌeꞌ. As la atin veꞌt oꞌ kꞌatz Aak tiꞌ chit ibꞌeneꞌ.
Estiꞌeꞌ ni qal sete, ekꞌujbꞌaꞌtaj chit tibꞌ ekꞌuꞌl sevatzaj tiꞌ unqꞌa yoleꞌ.
